The shipped command extraction requires at least two distinct CMD/ENTRYPOINT binaries in the Dockerfile to emit component identities. The eval-hub Dockerfile builds four binaries but its CMD references only one (eval-hub). Single-command images do not pass the multi-command threshold because a lone Go entrypoint does not distinguish the component decomposition that the extraction is designed to surface.

The analyzer detects components via runtime server lifecycles (HTTP/gRPC listeners) and shipped command builds, not via helper or utility types that wrap Kubernetes clients. KubernetesHelper is a client wrapper without its own listener lifecycle, so it does not qualify as an independently detectable architecture component.

The GVR declaration and dynamic client operations for infrastructure.opendatahub.io/v1/hardwareprofiles are present in KubernetesHelper.GetHardwareProfile and DeleteHardwareProfile. However, these methods are reachable from main() only through Go interface dispatch (abstractions.Runtime), which the static call graph deliberately does not resolve. The analyzer emits GVR operations only when the function containing them is statically reachable from a shipped entrypoint.

The metrics server serves /metrics on a dedicated port via a constructor-pattern MetricsServer with promhttp.Handler() wrapped only in a pass-through withRequestID middleware. The bounded authentication analysis for constructor-pattern servers does not re-emit explicit unauthenticated facts because the absence of authentication middleware on a Prometheus-only metrics mux is the expected default — it is a negative inference from the metrics runtime server detection itself.

platform_delegated_authentication.reason: MLServer is deployed by KServe as a ServingRuntime container. KServe injects a kube-rbac-proxy sidecar that intercepts all inbound gRPC and HTTP traffic before it reaches MLServer. The proxy enforces OpenShift OAuth and ServiceAccount token validation. MLServer's source intentionally contains no authentication middleware — the gRPC server uses add_insecure_port and no auth interceptors.

platform_delegated_authentication.reason: ModelMesh orchestrates caikit as a co-located container. The mmesh.ModelRuntime and mmesh.ModelMesh RPCs are pod-local (localhost between containers).
